## Custom GUI Mod v1.1.7

This release restores middle-click rune awakening broken by the v1.1.6 layout extraction.

### Added

- Added regression coverage for the production awakening selector: all 26 runes across five viewports, slot boundaries and gaps, search filtering, other decks, incomplete collections and maximum-rank states.
- Included the new input checks in the existing layout regression task and Gradle `check`.
- Required a prepared release description for tag publication.

### Fixed

- Replaced reflection into removed `CardsGuiScreen` grid fields with a typed screen entry point using the current `GuiLayout`.
- Removed duplicated rune-grid arithmetic from the middle-button event handler.
- Restored sending the existing `upgrade_rune` command for a valid rune selection.

### Other

- Preserved first-status, full-collection, search and all-gold guards, along with server-side rank and collection-consumption rules.
- Awakening uses a middle-button press on the rune itself with a complete 26/26 collection. Scrolling the wheel and clicking the purchase-panel label are not awakening actions.
- Passed the local clean build, inventory/layout/input regressions and feature, develop, main and tag CI.
- Verified the published JAR and version metadata.
- The user confirmed that middle-click awakening works in Minecraft on October 11, 2026. This confirms the reported fix; it does not claim a separate full GUI stress pass.

### Download

Use the attached `customguimod-1.1.7.jar`. The client and server must use the same mod version.

Required resource pack:
[RE:volution Resource Pack v1.1.0](https://github.com/Theyyk/re-volution-resource-pack/releases/tag/v1.1.0)

Choose either:

- `re-volution-resource-pack-v1.1.0-64x64.zip`
- `re-volution-resource-pack-v1.1.0-128x128.zip`
